requirements.title: CFI_select_part has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h part-selection interface
requirements.definition: CFI_select_part has the interface int CFI_select_part(CFI_cdesc_t *result, const CFI_cdesc_t *source, size_t displacement, size_t elem_len) and updates a descriptor for a section whose elements are parts of source elements.

pending.CFI_select_part-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares result and source CFI_cdesc_t pointers plus size_t displacement and elem_len values, and compiles an ordinary CFI_select_part call returning int.

requirements.title: CFI_select_part actual arguments must satisfy result, source, displacement, alignment, and element-length restrictions
requirements.definition: The result descriptor rank, attribute, and type, source descriptor state, displacement bounds and alignment, and character element length shall satisfy the stated restrictions.

pending.CFI_select_part-result-descriptor-restri: Positive component companion establishes a result descriptor with same rank as source, CFI_attribute_other, and type CFI_type_double before CFI_select_part.
pending.CFI_select_part-source-descriptor-restri: Source companion establishes a nonallocatable nonpointer rank-one descriptor over an array of interoperable C structures, not an assumed-size array.
pending.CFI_select_part-displacement-bounds-and-: Use offsetof(struct pair,y) as displacement for a double member y inside each source element; this value is within source elem_len and aligned by the C structure definition.
pending.CFI_select_part-character-elem-len: Character companion establishes source elements of length 5, selects displacement 1 with elem_len 3, and asserts the result element length is 3 for the substring descriptor.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_select_part describes component, substring, or complex-part arrays
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_select_part updates result base_addr, dim, and elem_len to describe an array section whose element is the selected component, substring, or real or imaginary part of the corresponding source element.

pending.CFI_select_part-updates-base-dim-elem-le: C companion defines struct pair { double x; double y; } source[3] with y values 10.5, 20.5, and 30.5, establishes a source descriptor with elem_len sizeof(struct pair), selects offsetof(struct pair,y), and asserts result base_addr equals &source[0].y, result extent is 3, result elem_len equals sizeof(double), and CFI_address subscript {1} equals &source[1].y.
pending.CFI_select_part-component-substring-comp: Component plan uses the struct y member and asserts result elem_len equals sizeof(double); substring plan uses a char[3][5] source selecting bytes 1 through 3 and asserts elem_len equals 3*sizeof(char) plus exact substrings bcd/BCD; complex plan selects real and imaginary parts of double _Complex values and asserts each result elem_len equals sizeof(double).

requirements.title: Detected CFI_select_part errors preserve the result descriptor
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_select_part error, the result descriptor is not modified.

pending.CFI_select_part-detected-error-preserves: C companion establishes a valid rank-one source descriptor over struct pair elements with elem_len sizeof(struct pair) and a valid result descriptor for double parts, snapshots result base_addr, elem_len, version, rank, attribute, type, and every dim lower_bound, extent, and sm member, calls CFI_select_part with displacement sizeof(struct pair), and asserts the returned indicator is CFI_ERROR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS from selecting outside the source element plus every snapshotted result member is unchanged.
